title: 2019 AMC 12B Problem 17
statement: How many nonzero complex numbers \(z\) have the property that \(0,\) \(z,\) and \(z^3,\) when represented by points in the complex plane, are the three distinct vertices of an equilateral triangle?

solutions.text:
The three points form an equilateral triangle iff \(|z|=|z^3|=|z^3-z|.\) From \(|z|=|z^3|=|z|^3\) we get \(|z|=1.\)

Then \(|z^3-z|=|z|\,|z^2-1|=|z^2-1|,\) so we need \(|z^2-1|=1.\) Writing \(z=e^{i\theta},\) \(|z^2-1|=2|\sin\theta|=1,\) so \(|\sin\theta|=\dfrac12.\)

This gives \(\theta=30^\circ,150^\circ,210^\circ,330^\circ,\) four values of \(z,\) all yielding distinct vertices.

Thus, D is the correct answer.
